name: Two Straws: Cruisin' for a Connection
source:
This was supposed to be just lunch (Seriously)

Another long day at the office and the only thing I look forward to is eating lunch at the cafeteria, but guess what? It's closed for cleaning and I missed the email update about it (I have it silenced but not my problem). Then I thought, maybe I'll grab a snack at the vending machine, but guess what? It ate my dollar and broke down. 

Just my luck right? Fine. Guess I'll eat out for once... 

A coworker suggested this place to eat lunch, couldn't find anything on the maps so I aimlessly wandered until I found it.

THE DINER in big neon red signage, this must be the place Dave mentioned. Looks like I'll have my lunch here then...now which waitress should I call to take my order?

AND HOW DID MY LUNCH BREAK TURN INTO ROMANCE!?

[From [url=https://bunnibambii.itch.io/twostrawscruisinforaconnection]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这本来只是午餐（说真的）又是在办公室漫长的一天，我唯一期待的就是在自助餐厅吃午餐，但你猜怎么着？它已关闭以进行清洁，我错过了有关它的电子邮件更新（我已将其静音，但不是我的问题）。然后我想，也许我会在自动售货机上买点零食，但你猜怎么着？它吃掉了我的美元并崩溃了。

只是我的运气好吗？美好的。看来我还是出去吃一次吧… 

一位同事建议在这里吃午餐，但在地图上找不到任何东西，所以我漫无目的地闲逛，直到找到它。

霓虹灯红色大标牌的餐厅，这一定是戴夫提到的地方。看来我要在这里吃午饭了……现在我应该打电话给哪位女服务员来点菜？

我的午餐是如何变成浪漫的！？

[来自[url=https://bunnibambii.itch.io/twostrawscruisinforaconnection]itch.io[/url]]
